items.followUp: How do starfish help maintain balance in a marine ecosystem?

rubric.why: Award for identifying starfish's role in controlling prey populations.
rubric.description: Starfish prey on organisms such as mussels and help control their populations.
rubric.how: Name mussels or another prey organism and state that starfish control its population.

rubric.why: Award for explaining how population control benefits the ecosystem.
rubric.description: This helps prevent one species from dominating and maintains ecosystem balance or biodiversity.
rubric.how: Link the control of prey populations to maintaining balance or biodiversity in the sea ecosystem.

modelAnswer: Starfish prey on organisms such as mussels and help control their populations.
This prevents one species from dominating and helps maintain balance and biodiversity in the sea ecosystem.
